verdict.rationale: Evidence documents vendor-specific acceleration only for Apple Silicon (MetalRT, M3+) and Qualcomm Hexagon NPU; there is no mention of NVIDIA CUDA/TensorRT or AMD ROCm kernels anywhere in the docs, GitHub, or community threads. The 'whatever silicon the device has' claim is generic marketing without concrete NVIDIA/AMD backend evidence. Missing for 10: any documentation, benchmark, or community report of running on NVIDIA or AMD GPUs with vendor-specific kernels.
